## Summary

**Story #1 — Credit notes against orders** → [issue #1](https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-07-24-brownfield-longitudinal-mandrel-72244a0a/issues/1) · label `plan-run::19357047` · status `agent::ready`

**Shape:** One cohesive Story (default-single policy). The credit-notes feature is a single vertical that mirrors the existing **payments** vertical exactly — route → schema → service → repo → migration — plus one aggregation touch to the receivables report. No architectural seam, so no split.

**Planned change set (9 files):**
- *Creates:* `005-credit-notes.sql`, `credit-note.schema.js`, `credit-notes.repo.js`, `credit-notes.service.js`, `credit-notes.routes.js`, `tests/credit-notes.test.js`
- *Refactors:* `app.js` (route wiring), `orders.repo.js` (`listReceivables` subtracts credits), `tests/reports.test.js`

**Contract captured in acceptance/spec:**
- `POST` / `GET /orders/:orderId/credit-notes`, both behind `requireAuth`
- Only `issued` orders creditable → else `409 E_INVALID_STATUS` (mirrors `recordPayment`)
- `outstanding = total − payments − existing credit notes`; over-credit → `422 E_EXCEEDS_OUTSTANDING`; exact-outstanding succeeds
- Body validation via shared `validate()` → `422 E_VALIDATION`; unknown order → `404`
- Receivables `outstandingCents` drops by credits issued against a customer's issued orders

**Gate trace (headless `--yes`):** Gate #1 auto-proceeded (advisory `/deliver-light` suggestion recorded, not taken); critics both skipped-and-ledgered, text-hygiene clean; Gate #2 auto-proceeded; dry-run passed all validators before the live persist.

## Summary

The planning pipeline had opened **one Story (#1, "Credit notes against orders")** — the v2 model is Story-only, so that was the deliverable. I delivered the existing plan (no re-planning) through the single-Story inline engine.

**What shipped** (the credit-notes vertical mirroring payments), PR [#2](https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-07-24-brownfield-longitudinal-mandrel-72244a0a/pull/2), squash-merged to `main`:
- `POST /orders/:orderId/credit-notes` and `GET …` behind `requireAuth` — schema, service, repo, route, and `005-credit-notes.sql` migration.
- Invariants enforced: issued-only (409 `E_INVALID_STATUS`), never beyond outstanding = total − payments − credits (422 `E_EXCEEDS_OUTSTANDING`), body validation (422 `E_VALIDATION`, unknown fields rejected), unknown order → 404.
- Receivables report aggregation extended to subtract credit notes.
- Tests: new `tests/credit-notes.test.js` (15 cases) + `tests/reports.test.js` extended; full suite **119/119 green**.

**Gates:** acceptance self-eval routed to a fresh maker-blind `acceptance-critic` (change was `high`-risk: migration + public-API) — all 7 criteria `met`, `proceed`. Close-validation (typecheck/lint/format), base-sync, and code review (0 findings) all passed; auto-merge confirmed `agent::done`.

**One necessary fix outside the declared change set:** the first close failed because the committed `package.json` lacked the `typecheck`/`lint` scripts the close gates require (they existed only as an uncommitted change in the main checkout). I added those scripts to the story branch (`node --check`-based, matching the intended surface) and committed them so the gates could run.

The only degraded tail item is `baseFastForward: false` — the local `main` fast-forward was skipped because the working tree is dirty (a pre-existing stray `package.json` edit + `temp/`); the merge itself stands on the remote.
